Localization.This Tool will install the Plugin to you:
This Tool will install the Plugin to your StreamDock Software.
The Software will be stopped/started during the Installation-Process.
Added/Changed Profiles, Images and Scripts will stay intact.
Localization.DO NOT run the Installer, Plugin or Stre:
DO NOT run the Installer, Plugin or StreamDock Software as Admin!
Running the Simulator or FSUIPC as Admin can eventually cause Connections-Issues!
PilotsDeck is 100% free and Open-Source. The Software and the Developer do not have any Affiliation to Flight Panels.
It is the actual Plugin allowing the StreamDock to interface with the Simulator and allowing the Creation of StreamDock Profiles for Airplanes.
Special Thanks to Fragtality for the original PilotsDeck Project!
